anchors.source_phrase: Falk et al. 2018: country patience vs average years of schooling ρ=0.65 (p<.01); individual patience–education coefficient positive in >90% of countries.
Falk et al. 2018 Table IV Corr(patience, risktaking)=0.230 (n=76); Hanushek et al. 2022 r=0.358 (n=49). θ=0.35 admits the published range and rejects r≳0.6.
Same human-capital implication as conv_edu, written as a leftover rank restriction (θ=0.15).
